notes.title: First fix and future news
notes.notes:
Greetings dear players! We wanted to tell you about the first major fix that is already solving the following in-game isues:
-Now you loose souls when you die
-Fixed: visual issues after diying in english version
-Fixed: visual issues after diying in spanish version
-Fixed: visual issues with the beacon in the fifth level of Crimson Foothills

We also thank you all for the bug reports. We intend to solve them in future patchs.
Well be adding joystick support in future versions, so stay tuned! 
Patching will not only fix issues, but also, we will be releasing new content including : levels, bosses, new playing modes, etc. 
We are currently working in an in-game store, so you can exchange your scored souls. More information about this in the future.
¡Thank you all for your time, and keep enjoying Bildo!
